cases.title: Cart total ignores item quantity
cases.report: Changing quantity to three leaves checkout at the one-item price.

cases.title: Free shipping starts too late
cases.report: At quantity two the $128 subtotal still has shipping charged; orders at least $100 should ship free.

cases.title: Decrease skips an item
cases.report: After increasing to three, one decrease jumps to one instead of two.

cases.title: Zero quantity breaks the lower bound
cases.report: Entering zero should clamp the occupied cart to one item, but it empties the bag.

cases.title: Line amount ignores quantity
cases.report: At three items checkout is correct but the line amount still shows $64 rather than $192.

cases.title: Order total subtracts delivery
cases.report: A one-item order shows an order total smaller than the $64 subtotal; delivery should add $8.

cases.title: Empty bag incurs delivery
cases.report: A fresh empty bag shows an $8 delivery charge instead of zero.

cases.title: Small orders receive free delivery
cases.report: A single $64 daypack receives free delivery even though free shipping requires at least $100.

cases.title: Increase skips a quantity
cases.report: After adding one item, one increase jumps to three rather than two.

cases.title: Repeated add resets the cart
cases.report: Clicking Add to bag again resets the count to one instead of incrementing to the nine-item limit.

cases.title: Large input exceeds the cart limit
cases.report: Entering 99 results in ten items; the documented maximum is nine.

cases.title: Blank quantity selects nine items
cases.report: Clearing quantity should fall back to one item, but it selects nine.
